content.summary: 南陽, the land the hereditary house records Han ceding to Qin in the ninth month of 231 BCE, when Qin sent troops to receive it. The sources name the territory but state neither its extent nor its seat; the record asserts no coordinate and does not use the modern city of the same name as a placement.

geometry.notes: The cited entries name 韓南陽 as ceded land and give no extent or seat. The record asserts no coordinate, and the modern city of the same name is not used, because the sources in this set do not identify the two.

content.editorial_notes: The name is shared with a later commandery and a modern city; the record keeps the source's name and makes no identification. A gazetteer that places the Han-era 南陽 is what would locate it.
